c74object.name: evi_cross
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Reimplementation of MSP cross~ filter as Likwitz-Riley
c74object.description:
evi_cross is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_cross.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_crossovers.genexpr
evi_cross is also available in MSP as: evi.cross~.
evi.cross~ differs from MSP cross~ in the following ways: evi.cross~ is a steeper 4-pole crossover slope (cross~ is a 3-pole slope), because 3rd order is not possible with flat summing Linkwitz-Riley. evi.cross~ is a proper Linkwitz-Riley crossover which sums perfectly flat (whereas cross~ is pure Butterworths and sums with a +3dB bump). evi.cross~ remains stable under modulation. For a shallower 2-pole Linkwitz-Riley crossover @see evi.crossover~.

geninlet.name: crossover
geninlet.digest: Frequency in Hz @min 10 @max 20000. The frequency at which to split the incoming audio into it's lowpass and highpass outputs.
